measure.name: ideal_loads_all_params
measure.description: Adds to the ideal loads air systems (Ideal Air Loads) a heat recovery unit on the ventilation air, an outdoor air economizer (free cooling) and occupancy-based ventilation. It quantifies the savings of heat recovery without modelling a real HVAC system. The heat recovery is ideal: no fan energy, pressure drop or frost control, and constant effectiveness.
measure.modeler_description: Edits the HVACTemplate:Zone:IdealLoadsAirSystem (Ideal Air Loads checkbox) and ZoneHVAC:IdealLoadsAirSystem (added from the library) objects of the translated IDF. IMPORTANT: with the Ideal Air Loads checkbox, OpenStudio 3.11 leaves the DSOA of the ideal loads empty and translates the DesignSpecification:OutdoorAir into ZoneVentilation:DesignFlowRate objects (per person with the occupancy schedule; the rest always on). That air does not go through the system, so heat recovery and economizer would have no effect. With 'Route the ventilation through the ideal loads' enabled, the measure assigns to each system the DSOA of its zone (the one in Sizing:Zone, which may be a DesignSpecification:OutdoorAir:SpaceList), sets Outdoor Air Method = DetailedSpecification and removes the ZoneVentilation objects generated by OpenStudio (only those with its names; user objects are kept). To compare cases, also simulate the base case with this measure and heat recovery = None, so that the outdoor air is identical. With DCV = OccupancySchedule the per-person part follows occupancy (as OpenStudio does by default); with None the design occupancy is used at all times. The DSOA schedule, if any, is applied. The economizer requires a maximum cooling air flow: if Cooling Limit is NoLimit it is changed to LimitFlowRate with Maximum Cooling Air Flow Rate = autosize (design days are required).

argument.name: heat_recovery_type
argument.description: Acts only on the outdoor air that goes through the ideal loads system, and only when the exhaust air is more favourable than the outdoor air.

argument.name: sensible_effectiveness
argument.description: Sensible Heat Recovery Effectiveness. EnergyPlus default: 0.70.

argument.name: latent_effectiveness
argument.description: Latent Heat Recovery Effectiveness. Used only with enthalpy heat recovery. EnergyPlus default: 0.65.

argument.name: economizer_type
argument.description: Increases the outdoor air when there is a cooling demand and the outdoor air is more favourable. Requires a cooling air flow limit (LimitFlowRate, autosize).

argument.name: route_outdoor_air
argument.display_name: Route the ventilation (DSOA) through the ideal loads
argument.description: Required for heat recovery and the economizer to work with the Ideal Air Loads checkbox: connects the zone DSOA and removes the ZoneVentilation objects generated by OpenStudio.

argument.name: dcv_type
argument.description: OccupancySchedule reproduces OpenStudio's default behaviour (the per-person part follows the occupancy schedule).

argument.name: zone_name_filter
argument.display_name: Apply only to zones whose name contains (empty = all)

argument.name: output_frequency
argument.description: Heat recovered, outdoor air, economizer hours, etc.
